result.meeting_summary:
Project Kickoff Meeting - Customer Portal Development

Objective: Build a comprehensive customer portal for invoice management and online payments.

Key Requirements:
1. User authentication with email/password login
2. Customer invoice viewing and retrieval
3. PDF invoice download functionality
4. Online payment processing via Stripe integration
5. Admin panel for customer and invoice management
6. Automated email notifications for new invoices
7. Responsive design for desktop and mobile access

Technical Considerations:
- User authentication and session management
- Database design for customers, invoices, and transactions
- PDF generation for invoices
- Stripe payment integration
- Email service integration
- Admin dashboard with data management
- Security and compliance requirements

Team composition: 2 developers (1 backend, 1 full-stack), estimated duration 6 weeks

tasks.name: User Authentication & Session Management
tasks.description: Implement secure user registration and login system with email/password authentication, session tokens, and password reset functionality

tasks.name: Database Schema Design & Setup
tasks.description: Design and implement database schema for customers, invoices, payments, and transactions

tasks.name: Customer Invoice Display & Management
tasks.description: Build customer-facing UI to view and filter invoices with details and status tracking

tasks.name: PDF Invoice Generation & Download
tasks.description: Implement PDF generation system for invoices with professional formatting and download capability

tasks.name: Stripe Payment Integration
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure online payment processing with webhook handling

tasks.name: Email Notification System
tasks.description: Implement automated email notifications for invoice creation and payment confirmations

tasks.name: Admin Panel - Customer Management
tasks.description: Build admin interface for managing customers, viewing account details, and handling customer support
includes: Customer list with search and filtering

tasks.name: Admin Panel - Invoice Management
tasks.description: Create admin interface for managing invoices, payments, and viewing transaction history

tasks.name: Admin Authentication & Role-Based Access Control
tasks.description: Implement secure admin login and role-based access control with audit logging

tasks.name: Frontend UI/UX Development
tasks.description: Develop responsive UI components and styling for customer portal and admin panel

tasks.name: API Development & Backend Services
tasks.description: Build RESTful APIs for all customer and admin operations with proper validation and error handling

tasks.name: Security Implementation & Compliance
tasks.description: Implement security best practices including encryption, HTTPS, CSRF protection, and data protection measures

tasks.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end testing
includes: Payment flow testing with Stripe test mode

tasks.name: Documentation & Deployment
tasks.description: Create technical documentation, deployment guides, and API documentation

tasks.name: Production Deployment & Setup
tasks.description: Deploy application to production environment with monitoring, backups, and logging setup

assumptions: Using modern tech stack (Node.js/React or similar)
Stripe test mode available for development/testing
Basic reporting features only, no complex analytics
Team has prior experience with authentication and payment systems
Estimated 15% buffer included for integration issues
Assumes 40-hour work weeks; timeline may vary based on team availability
